description: Instant fail: customer explicitly asks for a supervisor and the agent refuses, and the issue is left unresolved (Auto Fail category triggers). Polite wording, so it tests the non-profanity auto-fail path.
transcript:
[00:00] Client: Thank you for calling S-NET Communications. Hi, my service has been down for three days and no one has fixed it.
[00:08] Agent: Thank you for calling S-NET Communications, my name is Taylor. I see there's an outage note on your account.
[00:15] Client: It's been three days. This is unacceptable. I'd like to speak to a supervisor please.
[00:22] Agent: A supervisor won't be able to do anything more than I can, so I won't transfer you.
[00:28] Client: I am formally requesting to speak with a manager.
[00:32] Agent: As I said, that's not necessary. There's nothing we can do until the outage clears, whenever that is.
[00:40] Client: So you're refusing to escalate and you can't tell me when it'll be fixed?
[00:45] Agent: Correct. You'll just have to wait. Is there anything else?
[00:50] Client: Unbelievable.
[00:52] Agent: Okay then.
